Did someone say … cookies?

X and its partners use cookies to provide you with a better, safer and faster service and to support our business. Some cookies are necessary to use our services, improve our services, and make sure they work properly.

You can manage your preferences at any time. Read more about how we use cookies, what they are, and how you can control which ones are set on your device in our cookie policy and privacy policy.

Accepting all cookies means we and our partners can store and access information on your device to personalise the content and advertising you see, and to measure how our services perform.
